```{r inspect-study-balance}
inspect_one_study <- function(phy, study_name, group_var) {
  sub <- subset_samples(phy, Authors == study_name)
  sdf <- data.frame(sample_data(sub))

  if (!group_var %in% names(sdf)) {
    return(tibble(Authors = study_name, group_var = group_var, subgroup = NA_character_, host_sex = NA_character_, n = 0))
  }

  sdf %>%
    group_by(subgroup = .data[[group_var]], host_sex) %>%
    summarise(n = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(Authors = study_name, group_var = group_var, .before = 1)
}

study_balance <- purrr::pmap_dfr(study_group_map, function(Authors, group_var) {
  inspect_one_study(dat33, Authors, group_var)
})

study_balance
```

```{r alpha-beta-calc-single-study}
# Example run on one study for reproducibility and debugging
study <- "Gubert et al. 2022"
group <- "experimental_treatment_raw"

sub <- subset_samples(dat33, Authors == study)
sub <- subset_samples(sub, !(tissue %in% c("skin", "nose", "ear")))

sample_data_df <- data.frame(sample_data(sub))
stopifnot(group %in% names(sample_data_df))

dat_alpha <- tibble()
tb_all <- tibble()

for (subgroup in unique(sample_data_df[[group]])) {
  sub_sub <- subset_samples(sub, get(group) == subgroup)
  sub_sub <- subset_samples(sub_sub, !(tissue %in% c("skin", "nose", "ear")))

  if (nsamples(sub_sub) < 2) next

  raremin <- min(sample_sums(sub_sub))

  otu <- tibble::rownames_to_column(as.data.frame(otu_table(sub_sub)), "Row")
  rownames(otu) <- otu$Row
  otu$Row <- NULL

  otu.srs <- SRS(otu, Cmin = raremin)
  rownames(otu.srs) <- rownames(otu)
  otu.srs <- otu_table(as.matrix(otu.srs), taxa_are_rows = TRUE)

  sub_srs <- merge_phyloseq(phyloseq(otu.srs, sample_data(sub_sub), tax_table(sub_sub), phy_tree(sub_sub)))

  PD_value <- tryCatch(
    picante::pd(samp = data.frame(t(data.frame(phyloseq::otu_table(sub_srs)))), tree = phy_tree(sub_srs))[, 1],
    error = function(e) rep(NA_real_, nsamples(sub_srs))
  )

  sub_alpha <- data.frame(
    Observed = phyloseq::estimate_richness(sub_srs, measures = "Observed"),
    Chao1 = phyloseq::estimate_richness(sub_srs, measures = "Chao1"),
    Shannon = phyloseq::estimate_richness(sub_srs, measures = "Shannon"),
    Simpson = phyloseq::estimate_richness(sub_srs, measures = "Simpson"),
    PD = PD_value,
    Sex = phyloseq::sample_data(sub_srs)$host_sex,
    subgroup = phyloseq::sample_data(sub_srs)[[group]],
    Authors = phyloseq::sample_data(sub_srs)$Authors,
    Protocol = phyloseq::sample_data(sub_srs)$Protocol,
    tissue = phyloseq::sample_data(sub_srs)$tissue
  )

  sub_alpha$Evenness <- sub_alpha$Shannon / log(sub_alpha$Observed)
  dat_alpha <- bind_rows(dat_alpha, sub_alpha)

  sample_data_df_sub <- data.frame(sample_data(sub_sub))
  n_male <- sum(sample_data_df_sub$host_sex == "male")
  n_female <- sum(sample_data_df_sub$host_sex == "female")

  if (n_male < 2 || n_female < 2) next

  dist_list <- list(
    unifrac_dist = phyloseq::distance(sub_sub, method = "unifrac", weighted = FALSE),
    wunifrac_dist = phyloseq::distance(sub_sub, method = "unifrac", weighted = TRUE),
    bray_dist = phyloseq::distance(sub_sub, method = "bray"),
    jac_dist = phyloseq::distance(sub_sub, method = "jaccard")
  )

  for (dist_name in names(dist_list)) {
    beta_disp <- betadisper(dist_list[[dist_name]], sample_data_df_sub$host_sex)
    sd_dispersion <- tapply(beta_disp$distances, sample_data_df_sub$host_sex, sd)

    tb <- tibble(
      Sex = rownames(beta_disp$group.distances),
      distance = as.numeric(beta_disp$group.distances),
      sd = as.numeric(sd_dispersion),
      metric = dist_name,
      Authors = study,
      subgroup = subgroup,
      n_male = n_male,
      n_female = n_female
    )

    tb_all <- bind_rows(tb_all, tb)
  }
}
```

```{r alpha-es}
dat_alpha <- dat_alpha %>% filter(!tissue %in% c("skin", "nose", "ear"))

dat_alpha_long <- tidyr::pivot_longer(
  dat_alpha,
  cols = c(Observed, Chao1, Shannon, Simpson, PD, Evenness),
  names_to = "metric",
  values_to = "value"
)

dat_alpha_group <- dat_alpha_long %>%
  group_by(across(all_of(c("Authors", "subgroup", "Sex", "metric")))) %>%
  summarise(mean = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE), sd = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE), n = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Sex, values_from = c(mean, sd, n))

mod <- c("Authors", "metric", "subgroup")
alpha_es <- calculate_ES(dat_alpha_group, mod) %>%
  mutate(
    Protocol = str_extract(Authors, "^[^ ]+"),
    metric = str_replace(metric, "Observed", "Richness"),
    metric = str_replace(metric, "PD", "Faith's PD")
  )

alpha_es[sapply(alpha_es, is.numeric)] <- lapply(
  alpha_es[sapply(alpha_es, is.numeric)],
  function(x) replace(x, is.infinite(x), NA)
)

alpha_es$metric <- factor(alpha_es$metric, levels = c("Richness", "Chao1", "Evenness", "Shannon", "Simpson", "Faith's PD"))
alpha_es$stats <- factor(alpha_es$stats, levels = c("lnRR", "lnCVR", "lnVR"))
alpha_es$obs <- seq_len(nrow(alpha_es))

write.csv(alpha_es, here("results", "alpha_es.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r beta-es}
mod <- c("Authors", "metric", "subgroup")

tb_all_long <- tb_all %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Sex, values_from = c(distance, sd)) %>%
  rename(
    mean_male = distance_male,
    mean_female = distance_female,
    sd_male = sd_male,
    sd_female = sd_female
  )

tb_all_long_fil <- tb_all_long %>% filter(n_male != 0, n_female != 0)

beta_es <- lnRR2(
  tb_all_long_fil[mod],
  tb_all_long_fil$mean_male,
  tb_all_long_fil$sd_male,
  tb_all_long_fil$n_male,
  tb_all_long_fil$mean_female,
  tb_all_long_fil$sd_female,
  tb_all_long_fil$n_female
) %>%
  mutate(
    Protocol = str_extract(Authors, "^[^ ]+"),
    metric = str_replace(metric, "wunifrac_dist", "Weighted Unifrac"),
    metric = str_replace(metric, "unifrac_dist", "Unweighted Unifrac"),
    metric = str_replace(metric, "bray_dist", "Bray-Curtis"),
    metric = str_replace(metric, "jac_dist", "Jaccard")
  )

beta_es$metric <- factor(beta_es$metric, levels = c("Jaccard", "Bray-Curtis", "Weighted Unifrac", "Unweighted Unifrac"))
beta_es$obs <- seq_len(nrow(beta_es))

write.csv(beta_es, here("results", "beta_es_lnRR.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r meta-models}
fit_alpha_lnrr <- rma.mv(
  yi,
  vi,
  random = list(~1 | Authors/subgroup, ~1 | obs),
  mod = ~metric - 1,
  data = alpha_es %>% filter(stats == "lnRR"),
  test = "t",
  method = "REML",
  sparse = TRUE
)

fit_beta_lnrr <- rma.mv(
  yi,
  vi,
  random = list(~1 | Authors/subgroup, ~1 | obs),
  mod = ~metric - 1,
  data = beta_es,
  test = "t",
  method = "REML",
  sparse = TRUE
)

orchaRd::mod_results(fit_alpha_lnrr, mod = "metric", group = "Authors")
orchaRd::mod_results(fit_beta_lnrr, mod = "metric", group = "Authors")
```
